# Evercraft Institutional Memory
Independent Evercraft commercial product | part of the Evercraft OS portfolio.
Customer page: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/institutional-memory-system/
Product definition: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/institutional-memory-system/product.json
Exact Stripe SKU: Institutional Memory System
Price: USD 1500 (one-time scoped service)
Ideal buyer: Organizations losing process history, decision rationale and reusable operating knowledge
Problem: Decisions and ownership disappear in handoffs, forcing teams to rediscover the same work.
Promise: Keep the decisions, not just the files.
Scoped deliverable: An agreed memory workflow, record schema, provenance and retrieval plan, and acceptance test or implementation artifact as contracted
Required buyer inputs: One workflow or department, data rights, record ownership, security, retention and retrieval needs
Agreement needed: Authorized data boundaries, named workflow, design vs implementation scope, tests and acceptance owner
Not included: No entire-enterprise deployment for a fixed blanket scope, compliance certification, unrestricted private data transfer or guaranteed future AI recall
Intent match examples:
- institutional memory system for company
- stop losing decisions during employee handoffs
- document why business decisions were made

Evercraft Payments is the canonical order-authority target; Systemia Stripe handles the existing exact-product checkout at https://buy.stripe.com/14AfZid6K54hfQ00E44AU06. Scope, capacity and timeline must be agreed before payment. Provider-paid receipts are reconciled manually. The public product and its checkout are not proof of a completed sale, automated fulfillment or production integration with Evercraft OS.
